IAM and change systems check identity, authority, session, and allowed path.
SMERC checks recoverability, blast radius, rollback, cost velocity, fallback, and evidence before execution.
Shadow mirror metadata can test operational flow behavior without packet payloads or live AWS access.
Postcondition evidence checks whether the required route controls actually happened after the decision.
evidence_boundary: This is a local, metadata-only AWS-style review package. chain_stage_labels.bedrock_guardrail: Bedrock-style content/model guardrail reviews the prompt, response, or tool intent.
chain_stage_labels.cloud_execution_evidence: CloudTrail-, CloudWatch-, change-set-, runtime-, or tool-result-shaped evidence proves what actually happened.
chain_stage_labels.dynamic_iam_or_ssm: Dynamic IAM, Systems Manager, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, or another execution path receives only the route SMERC allows.

autonomy_budget.plain_english_summary: Autonomy should be suspended for this session because the action stream exhausted or violated the current autonomy budget. Human review should requalify the agent or tool family before more autonomous execution is allowed.

customer_evaluation.data_boundary: AWS-style metadata-only evaluation. No AWS account identifiers, ARNs, secrets, credentials, raw logs, private topology, customer data, source code, production commands, or live AWS access are included.
customer_evaluation.evidence_boundary: This is a metadata-only customer evaluation. It proves local runtime coherence on supplied action metadata; it does not prove production safety, compliance, incident reduction, customer demand, or readiness to enforce in a live environment.

pilot_fit.reason: The evaluation includes multiple side-effecting actions, at least one constrained path, and hard-stop cases worth reviewer labeling.

customer_evaluation.recommended_next_action: Use these results in a review call and ask the prospect to replace samples with 10 to 25 metadata-only actions from one real workflow.
